barbecue-planner.title: BBQ planner
barbecue-planner.description: Pick dishes and seasonings for 1–20 people: it works out purchase weights and skewer counts, seasoning and consumable quantities, marinade ratios, a grill timeline with real clock times, grate size, charcoal and safe core temperatures — with a checkable, strikable, printable list.

dish.noSearchResult: Nothing matches — try another word, or clear the box to browse the groups.

qty.hint: Auto: the engine splits each dish across what you picked, based on headcount. Manual: type a quantity on every picked card.

sauce.basicHint: Bottled and bagged seasonings you use straight away — only the checked ones reach the shopping list.
sauce.hint: {{picked}} of {{total}} selected. Mix rubs, bastes and dips to taste; marinades are not chosen here — they come with the meat you ordered.
sauce.noFit: Nothing on this table fits it

toolbar.needDishes: Nothing ordered yet — pick a few dishes and the totals and grate advice appear here.

recipe.refHint: Every mix we sourced is listed as-is. This is a reference, not your shopping sheet: it neither follows the dishes you picked nor scales to the head count. Choose what to buy under rubs & dips in the menu.

timeline.startHint: Clock times run back from {{time}}; a lead longer than midnight shows the previous day.

equipment.batchNote: Only the 150 cm tier has a sourced batch count; the rest are scaled by grate length.
equipment.heatNote: Aim above 200 ℃; two seconds over the grate is high heat, four is medium.
equipment.yakitoriTitle: Yakitori coal beds and indoor replicas
equipment.yieldBody: American quantities are already inflated by cooking yield (brisket 43 %, pork butt 50 %, loin 65 %, whole chicken 34 %). The rule of thumb is one finished pound per 2.6 people.

shop.qtyHint: Edit any quantity with − / + or by typing. Zero means "not this time" — the row stays on screen so you can undo it, but it leaves the copy text and the exported image. Quantities only change their own row: charcoal, skewer totals and marinade ratios keep running off the researched baseline.
shop.textHint: When the browser blocks clipboard access (non-HTTPS page, or the window lost focus), select and copy here. Rows set to zero never appear in this text.
shop.allDoneLine: No unchecked items left. Scan it once more before you head out.

barbecue-planner.emptyResult: Nothing is grillable with this combination — change the device or relax the diet switches.
barbecue-planner.conflictTitle: The sources disagree on these points; the tool takes no side — you choose the reading.
barbecue-planner.disclaimer: Compiled from published recipes, regulator guidance and industry standards — reference, not specification. Adjust to your own grill and ingredients.

chinese-kinship-calculator.title: Chinese Kinship Calculator
chinese-kinship-calculator.description: Pick or type a relation chain to get the exact Chinese kinship term, with reverse lookup from a term and a generation tree view.
chinese-kinship-calculator.chainEmpty: Tap the terms below, or type a chain like 爸爸的哥哥
chinese-kinship-calculator.resultEmpty: Tap a term to see how to address them
chinese-kinship-calculator.resultInvalid: Cannot resolve this chain — undo and try again
chinese-kinship-calculator.treeEmpty: Build a chain to see how the term is derived

fortune-draw.title: Daily Fortune Draw
fortune-draw.description: Shake the tube and draw your daily fortune — boosted luck on holidays, same name same result per day, all computed locally
fortune-draw.fixedHint: "Draw Today's Lot" stays fixed for the same name on the same day; "Random Draw" redraws every time, no limits
fortune-draw.emptyHint: Enter a name and draw your fortune for today
fortune-draw.disclaimer: For fun only | Trust science | No superstition

unit-converter.title: Unit Converter
unit-converter.description: Convert length, weight, data size, speed and area units with the factor shown, so you can check the math instead of guessing it.

ics-calendar-generator.title: ICS Calendar Event Generator
ics-calendar-generator.description: Fill in titles, locations, start and end times plus reminders for one or many events, then generate RFC 5545-compliant .ics files you can copy or download into any calendar.
ics-calendar-generator.outputPlaceholder: The calendar file appears once the event is filled in

timezone-meeting-planner.title: Timezone Meeting Planner
timezone-meeting-planner.description: Pick a base time and the cities involved to see each local date and time, UTC offset, day difference and working-hours status, plus the nearest slots where everyone is between 8:00 and 20:00.
timezone-meeting-planner.invalidBase: Invalid base time — pick another one
timezone-meeting-planner.emptyCities: No cities yet — add one to get started
timezone-meeting-planner.recommendHint: The nearest slots where every selected city is within 8:00–20:00 on a weekday, up to three.
timezone-meeting-planner.noSlot: No slot in the next 7 days has every city between 8:00 and 20:00 on a weekday.

bmi-calculator.title: BMI Calculator
bmi-calculator.description: Enter your height and weight to get your BMI, weight category and healthy weight range, with metric and imperial units and a clear scale indicator.
bmi-calculator.resultEmpty: Enter your height and weight to see the BMI result
bmi-calculator.emptyInput: Enter your height and weight to see the result
bmi-calculator.invalidInput: Invalid input: height must be 50–260 cm and weight 2–500 kg, both positive numbers.
bmi-calculator.disclaimer: BMI is a general health reference only and does not apply to pregnant people, children, athletes or people with high muscle mass.

tip-calculator.title: Tip Calculator
tip-calculator.description: Enter the bill, tip percentage and party size to see the tip, total and per-person share, with an optional round-up to a whole amount.
tip-calculator.roundUpHint: When on, the total is rounded up to a whole amount and the rounded per-person share is shown too.
tip-calculator.emptyInput: Enter the bill amount and number of people
tip-calculator.invalidInput: Invalid input: the bill must be above 0, the tip percentage between 0 and 100, and people an integer from 1 to 100.
tip-calculator.resultEmpty: Fill in the bill details to see the tip and per-person share

random-team-generator.title: Random Team Generator
random-team-generator.description: Paste a name list, choose a team count or team size, shuffle locally and split everyone into balanced random teams you can copy in one click.
random-team-generator.namesPlaceholder: One name per line, or separate with commas
random-team-generator.namesHint: Blank lines and duplicate names are dropped automatically; at least 2 people are required.
random-team-generator.invalidInput: Could not split: check the number of names, teams or people per team.
random-team-generator.resultEmpty: Enter names and press "Split teams" to see the result

water-intake-calculator.title: Water Intake Calculator
water-intake-calculator.description: Estimate your daily water target from body weight, exercise minutes and climate, shown in millilitres, litres and 250 ml cups.
water-intake-calculator.emptyInput: Enter your weight and exercise minutes
water-intake-calculator.invalidInput: Invalid input: weight must be 20–400 kg (44–882 lb) and exercise 0–1440 minutes.
water-intake-calculator.resultEmpty: Enter your weight and exercise minutes to see the target
water-intake-calculator.disclaimer: An estimate only; real needs vary with body composition, diet and exercise intensity.

fuel-cost-calculator.title: Fuel Cost Calculator
fuel-cost-calculator.description: Work out trip fuel cost and cost per kilometre from distance, consumption and fuel price, covering L/100km, km/L and MPG with a round-trip option.
fuel-cost-calculator.emptyInput: Enter distance, consumption and fuel price
fuel-cost-calculator.invalidInput: Invalid input: distance, consumption and price must all be above 0 and within sensible limits.
fuel-cost-calculator.resultEmpty: Fill in the trip details to see the fuel cost and cost per kilometre
fuel-cost-calculator.resultHint: Imperial results use US gallons (1 gal ≈ 3.785 L) and 1 mi ≈ 1.609 km.
